description: This file defines classes, structs, and functions related to task execution management within the ocudu namespace, including task queues, workers, execution contexts, and a task execution manager.

classes.name: task_execution_context
classes.description: Abstract base class for execution contexts that can dispatch tasks and be controlled (start/stop).

classes.name: task_execution_manager
classes.description: Manages multiple task execution contexts and their associated task executors.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all execution contexts managed by task_execution_manager.

methods.name: add_execution_context
methods.description: Adds a new task execution context to the manager.

methods.name: executors
methods.description: Returns a map of all task executors managed by the task_execution_manager.

methods.name: create_execution_context
methods.description: Factory functions to create different types of task execution contexts based on provided parameters.
